title: 2015 AMC 8 Problem 5
statement:
Billy’s basketball team scored the following points over the course of the first \(11\) games of the season:

\(42,\) \(47,\) \(53,\) \(53,\) \(58,\) \(58,\) \(58,\) \(61,\) \(64,\) \(65,\) \(73.\)

If his team scores \(40\) in the \(12\)th game, which of the following statistics will show an increase?

solutions.text:
When considering all \(12\) games, \(40,\) from the \(12\)th game, will be the lowest score. Therefore, compared to the range of just the first \(11\) games, the range of all \(12\) games would increase from \(73-42 = 31\) to \(73-40=33.\)

Thus, the correct answer is A .
hints: Adding \(40\) creates a new lowest score.
Check which statistic depends on the difference between the largest and smallest scores.
